_readme: The only price Elyx publishes is the starting price below. Every project is quoted to the client's requirements, so there are no ranges, tiers, calculators or per-item prices anywhere on the site. `projects` holds timelines only ({{weeks:KEY}} in articles). Edit, then run: node _src/build.js
gstNote: All prices are in INR and exclusive of GST.

landing.label: Landing page
landing.includes: 1 page, mobile-first design, enquiry form + WhatsApp button, basic SEO setup

website.label: Business website (5-10 pages)
website.includes: Up to 10 pages, CMS for editing, Google Maps, speed and SEO foundations

ecommerce.label: E-commerce store
ecommerce.includes: Catalogue, cart, UPI/card payments, order emails, admin panel

webapp.label: Custom web app / portal
webapp.includes: Logins, dashboards, your workflow turned into software

mobile.label: Mobile app (iOS + Android)
mobile.includes: One cross-platform codebase, store submission, push notifications

saas.label: SaaS MVP
saas.includes: Multi-tenant architecture, auth, billing, admin and analytics
